title: Moroccan Mrouzia
description: A rich and savory Moroccan dish featuring caramelized onions, nuka-pickle, and a hint of spices. It's a perfect comfort food for a chilly evening.
instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the beef short ribs and brown them on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the browned meat from the pot and set it aside.
Add more oil to the pot if necessary, then add the sliced onion and cook until caramelized, stirring occasionally, about 20 minutes.
Add the cumin, coriander, paprika, salt, and nutmeg to the pot and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the browned meat back to the pot, along with the nuka-pickle and caramel sauce.
Bring the mixture to a simmer, then cover the pot and transfer it to the oven.
Bake the mrouzia for 2 hours, or until the meat is tender and the sauce has thickened.
Serve the mrouzia hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or cilantro, if desired.
